# 🧰 Project Templates

Use these templates to make decisions and reviews repeatable. Replace placeholders and remove instructions that do not apply.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Architecture or policy decision |
| [Methodology review](methodology-review-template.md) | Emission factor or formula review |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Manual or automated validation |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Release readiness |
| [Change proposal](change-proposal-template.md) | Larger technical/product proposal |
| [Content approval](content-approval-template.md) | Public claims and copy |
